code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Separator rows and columns are the regularly spaced grid lines.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) > 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) > 1]
    # Keep the periodic line coordinates (all full separators).
    rs = row_lines
    cs = col_lines
    # In these puzzles the grid lines recur at a fixed stride; identify coordinates
    # from the separator color pattern by their variation across the orthogonal axis.
    # Interior rows/columns are constant, separators vary across cells.
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            corners=[grid[rs[i]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            bg=grid[rs[i]+1][cs[j]+1] if rs[i]+1<h and cs[j]+1<w else 0
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in (7,8) and all(x==corners[0] for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

            corners=[grid[rs[i]][cs[j]],grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]],grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]],grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            bg=grid[rs[i]+1][cs[j]+1]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] in (7,8) and all(x==corners[0] for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
